translation:
SEA-ALGO DECODE — gilgamesh_coligraph spec
==========================================

Glyph cells: Mu, Nu, Null  ->  null-state glyphs (Mu/Nu
  pair = dual-null markers; Null = the empty cell).

Artifact legend -> the relic register:
  Diamon(d) / Star / Pyramid / Temple gate /
  Wraith look star / Sumit(mit) shooting star III
  -> six graded relics, star-shooting as the apex tier.

Depiction schema (Wordpress dipiction):
  Acronym + Engraving + QR  ->  each artifact gets three
  renderings: short-form mark, engraved surface, scannable
  code. (dipiction kept as typed — 'depiction' reading)

Wordplay bindings:
  'Bab lons or lones'   -> Babylon or lone cells?
  'Grith for glyph'     -> grith/faith bound to glyph form
  'From Roman num left right is depiction plus'
                        -> roman-numeral anchors read
                           left-to-right as depiction marks

Directions:
  Sli der / Syl dir / Win dir  -> slider / sly / window
  direction triad — three traversal axes.

Cipher fragments (<> = slot operator):
  JL<>#C<>FH   -> J-L [slot] #C [slot] F-H  (hash-joined ends)
  Jvrf <>you   -> Jvrf [slot] you            (agent->patient)
  Lo <> box    -> Lo [slot] box              (container open)
  L=<          -> L equals-open              (assignment glyph)

Geometry notes:
  'Round is flat or floor or tile' -> round glyphs collapse
    to plane cells (floor/tile semantics)
  'Tuff-stone = expression is su'  -> tuff-stone surfaces
    carry 'su' expressions

Terminology: 'coligraph not calligraphy' — the marks are
  IMAGE-writing (coligraph), not pen strokes.

HONEST LIMIT: no cuneiform OCR engine on this machine
  (no tesseract/PIL); the clay tablet itself is NOT
  machine-decoded here. What IS decoded: the spec block's
  own notation -> this English reading. The tablet's
  scholarly content is anchored in the stored myth
  extracts (Ea leaks plan -> boat -> storm -> sacrifice
  -> immortality arc, Atrahasis/Utnapishtim lineage).
